## About
O'Brien Service is an independently owned shop at 242 W Marshall St in Ferndale, run by Frank O'Brien, master mechanic and founder. Frank started out working on his father's old pickup in the family garage, and he still spends his free time at local car shows and on his own restoration projects.
His philosophy is simple: "Do it right the first time, treat every vehicle as if it were your own, and never stop learning." We take the time to understand what's going on with your car, explain our process, and keep you in the loop until the job is done.
Our customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 53 Google reviews. Stop by or give us a call.

## Services
- Auto Diagnostics Services: Finding out what's actually going on with your car before we fix anything.
- Engine Repair Services: From diagnostics and repair to rebuilds and replacements.
- Timing belt replacement: One reviewer had a timing belt job done after getting an estimate from us, and said it came in under that estimate.
- Oil changes and fluid services: Oil changes, transmission maintenance and other vehicle fluid services.
- Brake pad and shoe replacement: Along with rotor and drum work, brake line repair and brake fluid flushes.
- Clutch replacement and repair: Manual transmission service, including clutch work.
- Pre-purchase inspections: Have us look over a used car before you sign anything.
- Free Air Fill: Our air fill station is free for customers who need to top off their tires.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I ask about an estimate before bringing my car in?
A: Yes. Give us a call with estimate questions or to talk through a complicated job. We stay in touch with you until the work is done.

Q: Can you inspect a used car before I buy it?
A: Yes, we do pre-purchase inspections. One family had us check a car from a nearby dealership, and we found it needed a new clutch.

Q: Will you tell me what's wrong before you do the work?
A: That's how we like to do it. We call with the rundown, explain the issues and go over the price before any work starts.

When I picked up my vehicle, they walked me through everything again and even showed me the parts that had been removed and replaced. It was truly an awesome experience. I am hoping I do not have any more car issues anytime soon, but if I do, I know exactly where I will be taking my vehicle." (Brandy Joe Plambeck, 5/5)
